name: The Corrupter
summary: Maurin Bonesplitter searches for a way to find The Corrupter, though its wards may foil scrying. He needs a Hatefury shadowstalker scalp from the old ruins in northeast Desolace, near Sargeron.

sections.title: Breaking the Wards
sections.body:
Maurin Bonesplitter believes the right reagents can reveal the demon lord. If Maurin is right about its power, those reagents must come from deadly creatures. He trusts you to face that danger in the Warchief's name.

First, the demon lord's wards against scrying must be broken. Maurin asks you for a satyr's scalp, and only a Hatefury shadowstalker's will serve. Search the old ruins in northeast Desolace, near Sargeron.

sections.title: The Right Scalp
sections.body: Maurin warns you to bring back the right scalp. Wrong reagents could get people killed, for the demon lord may have contingency spells meant to slay anyone who tries to scry on him. Fate has already dealt out enough pain, he says.

sections.title: When You Return
sections.body: Maurin judges the scalp fit for his spell. While you were away, he gathered some of the other reagents it needs and is nearly ready. Only a focus remains, an object that will cast the demon lord's image and reveal where he is.

faq.q: Who sends you to gather the scalp?
faq.answer: Maurin Bonesplitter asks you to bring him the scalp for a spell to find the demon lord.

faq.q: Why does Maurin specifically need a Hatefury shadowstalker scalp?
faq.answer: The demon lord may have wards against scrying, and Maurin needs a satyr's scalp to break them. Only a Hatefury shadowstalker's scalp will do.

faq.q: Where can the Hatefury shadowstalkers be found?
faq.answer: Hatefury shadowstalkers can be found in the old ruins of northeast Desolace, near Sargeron.

faq.q: What are the dangers of using the wrong reagents?
faq.answer: Maurin warns that the wrong reagents could cause deaths. The demon lord may have contingency spells meant to slay anyone who tries to scry on him.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the search for the demon lord?
faq.answer: This follows the first part of The Corrupter, when you brought the flayed demon skin to Maurin.
